pages.title: Under Stone, Over Trees
pages.text: Try two different prehistoric mounts and a wildlife landmark.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Follow each creature’s own taming instructions in the cave guide. They are separate animals, not upgrades of each other. The monolith is placed, not checked for spawning output. Optional care discoveries nearby: Relicheirus responds to Primordial Soup for its native tree-felling mechanic.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Vallumraptor first steals Dinosaur Nuggets from a chest; its native relaxing/taming sequence uses Serene Salad. These are guide leads, not extra mount requirements.
